# PromptShift

> PromptShift (https://promptshift.dev) is a sovereign, 1-click universal transpiler that converts complete AI assistant workspaces, developer guidelines, master prompts, and system rule definitions between Google Gemini / Antigravity, Anthropic Claude Projects, OpenAI Custom GPTs, Cursor, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot with 98.5% certified semantic fidelity and in-RAM zero-retention secret sanitization.

## Core Capabilities

- **Bidirectional Ecosystem Transpilation**: Converts system prompts, steering directives, tool schemas, and workspace configs across Cursor (`.cursorrules` & `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`), Anthropic Claude (`CLAUDE.md` & XML project instructions), OpenAI (`OPENAI_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md` & Assistants v2 JSON), and Google Gemini (`GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and Antigravity skills).
- **In-RAM Ephemeral Secret Redaction**: Detects and redacts sensitive credentials (Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe, AWS, HuggingFace, GitLab, Discord, GitHub tokens) directly in memory before writing converted files.
- **Certified Semantic Integrity (98.5%)**: Maps tone, autonomy thresholds, file references, role definitions, and negative constraints without loss of behavioral alignment.
- **Sovereign Privacy**: Zero server logs, zero disk writes, zero persistent database retention, zero third-party tracking cookies.

## Supported Migration Matrix

- **Cursor to Anthropic Claude**: Converts `.cursorrules` and modular `.mdc` rules into unified Claude Project system prompts and reference knowledge files.
- **Anthropic Claude to Cursor**: Splits monolithic Claude master prompts into modern Cursor modular rulebooks (`.cursorrules` + `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` with glob filters).
- **OpenAI Custom GPTs to Claude & Cursor**: Extracts GPT builder instructions and action schemas into clean Markdown instructions and local tooling configs.
- **Google Gemini / Antigravity to Multi-Platform**: Converts `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and custom agent skills into targeted format specs for Cursor, Claude, or OpenAI.

- **A2A Agent Discovery Card**: `https://promptshift.dev/.well-known/agent.json`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: `https://promptshift.dev/api/openapi.json`
- **CAPS JSON Schema**: `https://promptshift.dev/api/llms/schema`
- **GitHub Action**: `uses: topaisaas-dev/promptshift@v1` with `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` rich PR table.
- **CLI Bootstrap**: `npx promptshift` (or `npx promptshift --mcp` for STDIO MCP).
- **Dynamic Certification Badge**: `https://promptshift.dev/api/badge?score=98.5`
